verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents explicit egress policy for sandboxes. Allowlists and denylists can restrict which external domains, HTTP methods and URL paths a sandbox can reach. Outbound traffic routes through Blaxel's proxy, which supports per-domain firewalls. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the egress controls, and detail on non-HTTP (raw TCP/IP-level) egress restriction.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict or allow the sandbox's network egress with explicit policy

citations.quote: Restrict which external domains, HTTP methods, and URL paths a Blaxel sandbox can reach using allowlists and denylists to prevent data exfiltration and unwanted outbound traffic.
Route outbound sandbox traffic through Blaxel's proxy with MITM header and body injection, inject secrets, and configure per-domain firewalls.
